title: Tok Pisin 1
college: ANU College of Asia and the Pacific
requisiteText:
You cannot enrol in this course if you are a native speaker of Tok Pisin.

Students with previous experience of the language must sit a language proficiency assessment.

title: Tok Pisin 2
college: ANU College of Asia and the Pacific
requisiteText: To enrol in this course you must have completed TOKP1002, undertake a language proficiency assessment or be given permission by the course convener.
